seed_script.description: Seed 100 blog URLs from vendor.blog into field_monitor.url_registry + field_state (field: content_hash, hourly check). Idempotent via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.

execution_result.reason: vendor.blog is empty (just created). Script executed cleanly — will populate when blog vendor data is loaded.

validation_steps.step: SELECT count(*) FROM vendor.blog WHERE is_active = true;
SELECT count(*) FROM field_monitor.url_registry ur JOIN vendor.blog vb ON ur.domain = vb.domain AND ur.path = vb.path;
SELECT count(*) FROM field_monitor.field_state WHERE field_name = 'content_hash';
validation_steps.expected: Returns field_state count matching blog url_registry rows.
